title: Lower bounds for parameter-dependent oscillatory integrals and Fourier frames on hypersurfaces
summary: We prove lower bounds for Fourier transforms of surface measures $$|\widehat{ψ\,dσ}(ξ)| \gtrsim_{ψ, K, σ, R_0} σ(B(p, |ξ|^{-1})), \text{ given }p\in K\Subset\{ψ>0\} ,\ \vec{n}_{p}\parallel ξ,\ |ξ|\ge R_0,$$ on convex hypersurfaces of finite type with at most one vanishing principal curvature at each point. These bounds are uniform in the choice of $p\in K\Subset \{ψ>0\}$ and match the classical upper bound of Bruna-Nagel-Wainger.
